title: Chicken Bolognese with Fettuccine
intro: When the pasta craving hits mid-diet: 30 minutes, 50 g protein, and it still counts as diet food.

items: 6 garlic cloves, minced (+ 1 tsp garlic paste for extra zing)
¾ cup vegetable stock (or ½ cup water)
A handful of basil or parsley

method: Heat the oil, then add the garlic and onions.
Add the carrots if using, sauté, then the mushrooms. Cook till the water evaporates.
Add the capsicum and cook 2 minutes.
Add the chicken kheema and stir it through.
Mix in the tomato paste and purée.
Add the stock, salt, black pepper, basil, chilli flakes and coriander.
Cover and simmer 15–20 minutes till the kheema is fully cooked.
Add the fettuccine, cooked to about 70%, and let it finish in the sauce for 5 minutes. This is what makes the pasta taste of the sauce and thickens everything.
Plate up and top with cheese.
tips: Too wet? Turn the flame to high for 5–6 minutes and it dries out.
Less pasta for fewer carbs, more kheema for more protein.

Vegetarian? Swap the chicken for 1 cup soya granules: soak in hot water for 10 minutes, squeeze dry, add at step 4 and simmer 10 minutes instead of 20. Crumbled paneer works too, but add it at the end so it stays soft.
